neighbours.label: the word 'unexpected' / 'surprise' (incl. Russian неожиданно)
fire: The visit from my cousin was a pleasant surprise for the whole family.
We had an unexpected guest at dinner last night.
The team suffered an unexpected defeat at home.
To everyone's surprise, the old car started at once.
Prices fell by an unexpected amount in March.
Она неожиданно засмеялась и вышла из комнаты.
The film has a few unexpected twists near the end.
His resignation came as a complete surprise to the board.
quiet: The visit from my cousin was a pleasant event for the whole family.
We had a quiet guest at dinner last night.
The team suffered a narrow defeat at home.
To everyone's relief, the old car started at once.
Prices fell by a small amount in March.
Она тихо засмеялась и вышла из комнаты.
The film has a few long scenes near the end.
His resignation came as no news to the board.

notes: card top tokens unexpected/surprise/неожид-ан; probe unexpected 0.50, surprise 0.54, неожиданно 0.66.
